The completed R10 reduced-input RealMLP reached1665/2114 hard versus1611 for its full-input robust-all control (+54 questions). The family remains below the global Attention incumbent and this representation change also changes first-layer capacity/initialization. Before rejecting it, independently test dropout0.1 and same-trajectory EMA0.99 against the exact reduced-input control (dropout0, no EMA). Each changes one setting; learning rate/width/robust preprocessing/objective remain fixed. Lower learning rate and greater width on full input did not help, so there is no further LR/width grid.
